notes: Latest WaterNSW annual report discovered from the official annual-report page (no hard-coded PDF URL) and archived with SHA-256 outside the repo. The consolidated face statement prints an explicit $’000 unit. Total expenses is an explicit printed total and is accepted only when the printed revenue/expense components and the operating-profit, profit-before-tax and net-result bridges reconcile exactly, and Note 3 grants sum to the statement Grants and subsidies line. Deep detail adds the printed note tables: Note 2 water-supply segments, Note 4 other-revenue categories, Note 5 employee-expense components, Note 6 other-operating-expense categories, Note 7 depreciation components, Note 8 finance-cost components and the cash-flow capital-expenditure outflow. Every note component is accepted only when its printed signs sum exactly to its printed note subtotal, and every row is marked soc_component_of that subtotal so it is never added to the entity total. Every row is a provisional, unverified entity-level SOC statement line (jurisdiction_level=soc, aggregation_role=agency_detail); never add WaterNSW rows to government program spending, the PNFC benchmark, Sydney Water, or each other.
